name: Sparsh Shrivastava
bio: Sparsh Shrivastava (born 4 July 1999) is an Indian actor. One of his first roles was in the series Balika Vadhu. He is known for his role of Deepak in 2024 Bollywood movie Laapataa Ladies.

credits.title: Vrushakarma
credits.overview: In a desperate quest to decode ancient cave carvings, a treasure hunter hungry for untold riches, an obsessed archaeologist, and a devoted history student race against time to unravel a prophecy tied to royal lineage and the impending apocalypse, confronting the forces of destiny and evil along the way.

credits.title: Vibe
credits.overview: A clueless slacker and his by-the-book best friend -- two men who can barely manage their own lives -- find the fate of the nation in their hands when they accidentally stumble into a terrorist conspiracy.

credits.title: Ae Watan Mere Watan
credits.overview: In the midst of India's struggle for freedom in 1942, a brave young girl starts an underground radio station to spread the message of unity, setting off a thrilling chase with the British authorities during the Quit India movement.

credits.title: Lost Ladies
credits.overview: In 2001, somewhere in rural India, two young brides get accidentally swapped on a train. In the ensuing chaos, they both encounter a host of colourful characters, resulting in hilarious and unexpected consequences.

credits.title: Collar Bomb
credits.overview: A celebrated cop is forced to commit crimes before a suicide bomber blows up a school. As he races against time, the idyllic town around him descends into chaos.

credits.title: Natkhat
credits.overview: One evening, seven-year-old Sonu casually alludes to a ghastly act that he committed in school. Horrified and determined to correct his course, his doting mother Surekha decides that she won’t let him go down the same path as the other machismo-obsessed men in his family.
